name: Release Candidate Preparation
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: candidate-preparation-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  qualify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify qualified source checkout
        env:
          QUALIFICATION_SOURCE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$QUALIFICATION_SOURCE"
          printf 'QUALIFIED_SOURCE_COMMIT=%s\n' "$QUALIFICATION_SOURCE"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version: 22.23.2
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm --prefix hardhat ci
      - name: Source and dependency compatibility boundaries
        id: source-policy
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          manifest_sha=$(sha256sum config/manager-transformational-v1.json | cut -d' ' -f1)
          verifier_sha=$(sha256sum scripts/release/transformational-profile.py | cut -d' ' -f1)
          python3 scripts/release/transformational-profile.py --dependency-root "$(realpath node_modules)"
          printf 'manifest=%s\nverifier=%s\n' "$manifest_sha" "$verifier_sha" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Compile reviewed candidate contracts
        run: npm run build
      - name: Complete preflight and real entrypoint regressions
        run: npm --prefix hardhat run test:preflight
      - name: Native compiler, provider, storage and historical runtime compatibility
        run: npm --prefix hardhat run test:registry-native
      - name: Check bytecode sizes
        run: npm run size
      - name: Verify active guide and metadata alignment
        run: npm run docs:check
      - name: Test release qualification gates offline
        run: |
          python3 scripts/release/test-release-gates.py
          python3 scripts/release/test-dependency-boundaries.py
          python3 scripts/release/run-inherited-source-tests.py --dependency-root "$(realpath node_modules)"
          python3 scripts/release/run-inherited-release-tests.py
      - name: Native transformation profile and inherited release tests
        run: |
          python3 scripts/release/test-transformational-profile.py
          python3 scripts/release/test-transformational-qualification.py
          python3 scripts/release/test-publication-authorization-ti.py
          python3 scripts/release/test-pages-publication-ti.py
          python3 scripts/release/run-transformational-inherited-tests.py
      - name: Resolve candidate identity from package metadata
        id: candidate
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os, re, sys
          sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts/release')
          from release_common import TAG
          if not re.fullmatch(r'v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+', TAG):
              raise ValueError('Unsupported release tag')
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a') as output:
              output.write(f'tag={TAG}\n')
          PY
      - name: Build and independently rebuild candidate assets
        env:
          CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_SHA: ${{ steps.source-policy.outputs.manifest }}
          CANDIDATE_VERIFIER_SHA: ${{ steps.source-policy.outputs.verifier }}
        run: |
          for output in "build/release/${{ steps.candidate.outputs.tag }}-candidate" /tmp/agi-candidate-rebuild; do
            python3 scripts/release/package-release.py --out "$output" \
              --profile manager-transformational-v1 --object-store "$PWD" \
              --dependency-root "$(realpath node_modules)" \
              --manifest config/manager-transformational-v1.json \
              --manifest-sha256 "$CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_SHA" \
              --verifier-sha256 "$CANDIDATE_VERIFIER_SHA"
          done
          diff -r "build/release/${{ steps.candidate.outputs.tag }}-candidate" /tmp/agi-candidate-rebuild
      - name: Clean extraction and offline smoke test
        env:
          CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_SHA: ${{ steps.source-policy.outputs.manifest }}
          CANDIDATE_VERIFIER_SHA: ${{ steps.source-policy.outputs.verifier }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/release/verify-package.py "build/release/${{ steps.candidate.outputs.tag }}-candidate" \
            --profile manager-transformational-v1 --manifest config/manager-transformational-v1.json \
            --manifest-sha256 "$CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_SHA" \
            --verifier-sha256 "$CANDIDATE_VERIFIER_SHA"
      - name: Retain source-pinned candidate assets
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: AGIJobManager-${{ steps.candidate.outputs.tag }}-candidate-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: build/release/${{ steps.candidate.outputs.tag }}-candidate/
          if-no-files-found: error
# Deliberately no publish job and no contents:write permission.
# Publication needs separately reviewed final-source CI metadata and authorization.

    inputs:
      confirmation:
        description: 'Enter PUBLISH_v1.19.5 after reviewing completed final-source qualification'
        required: true
        type: string

  actions: read

  group: publish-v1.19.5
  cancel-in-progress: false

  publish:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.confirmation == 'PUBLISH_v1.19.5'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 65
    env:
      SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ github.sha }}
      RELEASE_PUBLISH_CONFIRMATION: ${{ inputs.confirmation }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

        with:
          node-version: 22.23.2

      - name: Wait for all eight exact-source workflows
        id: readiness
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 scripts/release/wait-qualification.py --source "$SOURCE_COMMIT"
      - name: Refuse superseded or unready publication
        if: steps.readiness.outputs.ready != 'true'
        run: exit 1
      - name: Consume completed exact-source runs and immutable candidate artifact
        if: steps.readiness.outputs.ready == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 scripts/release/collect-qualification.py --source "$SOURCE_COMMIT" --out build/release/v1.19.5 --profile manager-transformational-v1 --manifest config/manager-transformational-v1.json --manifest-sha256 "$(sha256sum config/manager-transformational-v1.json | cut -d' ' -f1)" --verifier-sha256 "$(sha256sum scripts/release/transformational-profile.py | cut -d' ' -f1)"

        if: steps.readiness.outputs.ready == 'true'
        run: python3 scripts/release/verify-package.py build/release/v1.19.5 --published --profile manager-transformational-v1 --manifest config/manager-transformational-v1.json --manifest-sha256 "$(sha256sum config/manager-transformational-v1.json | cut -d' ' -f1)" --verifier-sha256 "$(sha256sum scripts/release/transformational-profile.py | cut -d' ' -f1)"

"""Collect completed final-main-source runs and their immutable candidate artifact."""
import argparse
import runpy
import datetime
import json
import os
import pathlib
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile
import zipfile
from release_common import REPOSITORY, TAG, TITLE, WORKFLOWS, BUILDER_ASSETS, require, valid_sha, validate_qualification, verify_assets, sha

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--source', required=True)
parser.add_argument('--out', type=pathlib.Path, required=True)
policy = runpy.run_path(str(pathlib.Path(__file__).with_name('package-policy.py')))
policy['add_selection_arguments'](parser)
args = parser.parse_args()
source_policy = policy['select'](args.profile, manifest=args.manifest, manifest_sha256=args.manifest_sha256, verifier_sha256=args.verifier_sha256, schema_sha256=args.schema_sha256, published=True)
profile_args = ['--profile', args.profile]
for option in ('manifest', 'manifest_sha256', 'verifier_sha256', 'schema_sha256'):
    value = getattr(args, option)
    if value is not None:
        profile_args.extend(['--' + option.replace('_', '-'), value])
require(valid_sha(args.source), 'Source must be a full commit SHA')
require(os.environ.get('GITHUB_REPOSITORY') == REPOSITORY, 'Repository identity differs')

def gh(*command):
    result = subprocess.run(['gh', *command], cwd=root, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=180)
    require(result.returncode == 0, 'GitHub request failed; check authenticated Actions access (response withheld to protect signed URLs)')
    return result.stdout

def api(endpoint):
    return json.loads(gh('api', f'repos/{REPOSITORY}/{endpoint}', '--method', 'GET'))

runpy.run_path(str(pathlib.Path(__file__).with_name('publication-authorization-ti.py' if source_policy and source_policy.get('releaseProfile') == 'manager-transformational-v1' else 'publication-authorization.py')))['authorize'](os.environ, args.source, api)
require(api('git/ref/heads/main')['object']['sha'] == args.source, 'Source must be current main')
config = {'repository': REPOSITORY, 'tag': TAG, 'name': TITLE, 'status': 'qualified', 'publicationAuthorized': True,
    'sourceCommit': args.source, 'sourceTree': api(f'git/commits/{args.source}')['tree']['sha'], 'checkoutCommit': args.source,
    'releaseDate': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).date().isoformat(), 'requiredSourceRuns': {},
    'scope': 'Software qualification. Historical mainnet evidence is separate; no public-chain writes or intake activation.', 'artifactDigests': {}}
if source_policy is not None:
    config['sourcePolicy'] = source_policy
for workflow in WORKFLOWS:
    identity = api(f'actions/workflows/{workflow}')
    runs = api(f'actions/workflows/{identity["id"]}/runs?head_sha={args.source}&event=push&per_page=100')['workflow_runs']
    candidates = sorted((r for r in runs if r['head_sha'] == args.source and r['head_branch'] == 'main'), key=lambda r: r['id'], reverse=True)
    require(bool(candidates), 'Missing final-source run: ' + workflow)
    run = candidates[0]
    config['requiredSourceRuns'][workflow] = {'id': run['id'], 'workflow': workflow, 'workflowId': identity['id'], 'attempt': run['run_attempt'], 'event': run['event'], 'headBranch': run['head_branch']}
validate_qualification(config, api, lambda job: gh('api', f'repos/{REPOSITORY}/actions/jobs/{job}/logs', '--method', 'GET', '--allow-escape-sequences'), publication=True)
if source_policy and source_policy.get('releaseProfile') == 'manager-transformational-v1':
    config['transformationQualification'] = runpy.run_path(str(pathlib.Path(__file__).with_name('transformational-qualification.py')))['validate'](config, api, lambda job: gh('api', f'repos/{REPOSITORY}/actions/jobs/{job}/logs', '--method', 'GET', '--allow-escape-sequences'))
run_id = config['requiredSourceRuns']['current-state-release.yml']['id']
artifacts, page = [], 1
while True:
    batch = api(f'actions/runs/{run_id}/artifacts?per_page=100&page={page}')['artifacts']
    artifacts.extend(batch)
    if len(batch) < 100:
        break
    page += 1
matches = [a for a in artifacts if a['name'] == f'AGIJobManager-{TAG}-candidate-{args.source}']
require(len(matches) == 1 and not matches[0]['expired'] and re.fullmatch('sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', matches[0].get('digest', '')), 'Missing or ambiguous immutable candidate artifact')
artifact = matches[0]
require(artifact['workflow_run']['head_sha'] == args.source, 'Artifact source differs')
require(not args.out.exists(), 'Output must be new')
args.out.mkdir(parents=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='v114-artifact-') as temp:
    downloaded = pathlib.Path(temp) / 'artifact.zip'
    with downloaded.open('wb') as stream:
        result = subprocess.run(['gh', 'api', f'repos/{REPOSITORY}/actions/artifacts/{artifact["id"]}/zip'], cwd=root, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=180)
    require(result.returncode == 0 and 'sha256:' + sha(downloaded.read_bytes()) == artifact['digest'], 'Candidate artifact download/digest mismatch')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(downloaded) as archive:
        allowed = {f'AGIJobManager-{TAG}-COMPLETE.zip', 'agijobmanager-usdc.html', 'RELEASE_MANIFEST.json', 'SHA256SUMS.txt'} | BUILDER_ASSETS
        require(set(archive.namelist()) == allowed and len(archive.infolist()) == len(allowed), 'Unexpected artifact contents')
        for name in allowed:
            (args.out / name).write_bytes(archive.read(name))
config['candidateArtifact'] = {k: artifact[k] for k in ['id', 'name', 'digest', 'size_in_bytes']}
digests = verify_assets(args.out)
config['artifactDigests'] = {n: d for n, d in digests.items() if n != 'SHA256SUMS.txt'}
manifest = json.loads((args.out / 'RELEASE_MANIFEST.json').read_text())
require(manifest['sourceCommit'] == args.source and manifest['sourceTree'] == config['sourceTree'], 'Candidate manifest source differs')
subprocess.run(['python3', 'scripts/release/verify-package.py', str(args.out.resolve()), *profile_args], cwd=root, check=True)
(args.out / 'QUALIFICATION.json').write_text(json.dumps(config, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
(args.out / 'SHA256SUMS.txt').write_text(''.join(f'{sha(f.read_bytes())}  {f.name}\n' for f in sorted(args.out.iterdir()) if f.name != 'SHA256SUMS.txt'))
verify_assets(args.out, config)
print(f'Final-source qualification retained for {args.source}. No release or tag was created.')

"""Safely extract the exact package, verify complete inventory, and run offline smoke checks."""
import argparse
import json
import pathlib
import runpy
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from release_common import TAG, TITLE, REPOSITORY, WORKFLOWS, LIMIT, require, sha, valid_sha, verify_assets, source_path, verify_builder_rebuild, verify_builder_context_outputs, strict_json
from release_common import builder_reconstruction, retained_builder_package

candidate_policy = runpy.run_path(str(pathlib.Path(__file__).with_name('package-policy.py')))

def package_inventory(assets, *, published=False, profile='legacy-v114', manifest=None,
                      manifest_sha256=None, verifier_sha256=None, schema_sha256=None):
    """Verify local bytes and recorded bindings, without claiming live CI/provenance verification."""
    selection = candidate_policy['select'](profile, manifest=manifest, manifest_sha256=manifest_sha256,
        verifier_sha256=verifier_sha256, schema_sha256=schema_sha256, published=published)
    config = None
    if published:
        qualification = assets / 'QUALIFICATION.json'
        require(qualification.is_file() and not qualification.is_symlink() and qualification.stat().st_size < 1_000_000, 'Published qualification is missing or oversized')
        config = json.loads(qualification.read_text())
        require(config.get('repository') == REPOSITORY and config.get('tag') == TAG and config.get('name') == TITLE and config.get('status') == 'qualified', 'Published qualification identity differs')
        require(valid_sha(config.get('sourceCommit')) and valid_sha(config.get('sourceTree')) and config.get('checkoutCommit') == config['sourceCommit'], 'Published source binding differs')
        require(set(config.get('requiredSourceRuns', {})) == set(WORKFLOWS), f'Published qualification must record all {len(WORKFLOWS)} workflows')
    if published and selection and selection.get('releaseProfile') == 'manager-transformational-v1':
        runpy.run_path(str(pathlib.Path(__file__).with_name('transformational-qualification.py')))['verify_record'](config)
    verify_assets(assets, config)
    manifest_bytes = (assets / 'RELEASE_MANIFEST.json').read_bytes()
    manifest = strict_json(manifest_bytes)
    require(valid_sha(manifest.get('sourceCommit')) and valid_sha(manifest.get('sourceTree')), 'Invalid manifest source identity')
    candidate_policy['validate_metadata'](manifest, selection)
    return manifest, manifest_bytes

def archive_inventory(archive, manifest):
    """Bound every entry and the total expansion before decompressing any entry."""
    prefix = f'AGIJobManager-{TAG}/'
    require(isinstance(manifest.get('files'), dict) and len(manifest['files']) < 20_000, 'Invalid or oversized source inventory')
    expected = set(manifest['files']) | {'RELEASE_MANIFEST.json'}
    require(len(archive.infolist()) == len(expected) and {i.filename for i in archive.infolist()} == {prefix + n for n in expected}, 'Archive inventory is incomplete or contains extras/duplicates')
    require(sum(item.file_size for item in archive.infolist()) < LIMIT, 'Archive expanded size exceeds the package limit')
    for item in archive.infolist():
        require(item.filename.startswith(prefix), 'Archive prefix differs')
        name = item.filename[len(prefix):]
        path = pathlib.PurePosixPath(name)
        require(path.as_posix() == name and not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts and '\\' not in name, 'Unsafe archive path')
        require(not name.startswith('source/hardhat/contracts/'), 'Archive entries must not traverse the retained contracts symlink')
        mode = item.external_attr >> 16
        require((stat.S_ISREG(mode) or (name == 'source/hardhat/contracts' and stat.S_ISLNK(mode))) and item.file_size < LIMIT, 'Unsupported archive entry')
        if name.startswith('source/'):
            source_path(name[len('source/'):], mode)
    return prefix

def verify_package(assets, *, published=False, profile='legacy-v114', manifest=None,
                   manifest_sha256=None, verifier_sha256=None, schema_sha256=None):
    assets = pathlib.Path(assets)
    options = dict(profile=profile, manifest=manifest, manifest_sha256=manifest_sha256,
        verifier_sha256=verifier_sha256, schema_sha256=schema_sha256)
    selection = candidate_policy['select'](**options, published=published)
    manifest, manifest_bytes = package_inventory(assets, published=published, **options)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='agijobmanager-package-smoke-') as temp, zipfile.ZipFile(assets / f'AGIJobManager-{TAG}-COMPLETE.zip') as archive:
        prefix = archive_inventory(archive, manifest)
        for item in archive.infolist():
            name = item.filename[len(prefix):]
            mode = item.external_attr >> 16
            data = archive.read(item)  # Reading checks the CRC after the bounded inventory review.
            if name == 'RELEASE_MANIFEST.json':
                require(data == manifest_bytes, 'Embedded manifest differs')
            else:
                details = manifest['files'][name]
                require(len(data) == details['bytes'] and sha(data) == details['sha256'] and mode == details['mode'], 'Payload identity differs: ' + name)
            target = pathlib.Path(temp) / name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if stat.S_ISLNK(mode):
                require(name == 'source/hardhat/contracts' and data == b'../contracts', 'Unsafe symlink target')
                require((target.parent / data.decode()).resolve() == pathlib.Path(temp) / 'source/contracts', 'Symlink escapes source')
                target.symlink_to('../contracts', target_is_directory=True)
            else:
                target.write_bytes(data)
                target.chmod(mode & 0o777)
        require((pathlib.Path(temp) / 'agijobmanager-usdc.html').read_bytes() == (assets / 'agijobmanager-usdc.html').read_bytes(), 'Standalone console differs')
        source_dir = pathlib.Path(temp) / 'source'
        if selection is not None:
            candidate_policy['validate_source'](source_dir, selection)
        regenerated = pathlib.Path(temp) / 'rebuilt'
        selected_package = retained_builder_package(temp)
        with builder_reconstruction(source_dir, manifest.get('builderSource'), selected_package):
            verify_builder_context_outputs(manifest['builderSource'], temp)
            subprocess.run(['node', 'scripts/successor/build.mjs', '--out', str(regenerated)], cwd=source_dir, check=True)
            verify_builder_rebuild(regenerated, assets, temp)
            subprocess.run(['node', '--test', 'scripts/successor/portable.test.mjs'], cwd=source_dir, check=True)
        subprocess.run(['node', 'scripts/release/verify-usdc-ui.mjs', '.'], cwd=source_dir, check=True)
        subprocess.run(['python3', 'scripts/release/test-release-gates.py'], cwd=source_dir, check=True)
        if selection is not None and selection.get('releaseProfile') == 'manager-transformational-v1':
            subprocess.run(['node', '--test', 'scripts/integrations/transformational-work-request.test.mjs', 'scripts/integrations/transformational-native-source.test.mjs'], cwd=source_dir, check=True)
            subprocess.run(['python3', 'scripts/release/test-transformational-qualification.py'], cwd=source_dir, check=True)
            subprocess.run(['python3', 'scripts/release/test-publication-authorization-ti.py'], cwd=source_dir, check=True)
    print('Verified complete inventory and clean-extraction offline smoke checks. No wallet, credentials or network required.')
    if selection is not None and 'releaseProfile' not in selection:
        print('Candidate source package only: input identity is bound; release identity is unselected and release qualification is false.')
    if published:
        print('Published qualification bindings match. Live CI status, release authenticity and attestations must be verified separately.')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('assets', type=pathlib.Path)
    parser.add_argument('--published', action='store_true', help='Require the complete published inventory, including QUALIFICATION.json and its exact asset/source bindings')
    candidate_policy['add_selection_arguments'](parser)
    verify_package(**vars(parser.parse_args()))
